name: Jordan Rivera
title: Data Engineer
summary: Data engineer building batch and streaming pipelines, focused on reliability and cost-aware infrastructure.

bullets: Rebuilt the nightly ingestion pipeline on Airflow, cutting failed-run incidents by roughly 40%.
Migrated a legacy warehouse to Snowflake, reducing query latency by roughly 3x for analytics dashboards.
Introduced dbt-based data quality tests, catching schema drift before it reached (-15% downstream reporting errors).
Containerized the team's batch jobs with Docker and moved orchestration to Kubernetes, cutting deployment time by roughly 35%.
Built a Kafka-based streaming pipeline processing 500GB/day across 12 sources.
Wrote Terraform modules to provision the team's AWS data infrastructure.
Tuned SQL queries against Redshift, cutting the daily reporting job's runtime by roughly 30%.
Wrote Scala Spark jobs on GCP Dataproc to process point-of-sale data across 300+ stores.
Built scikit-learn based anomaly detection for inventory counts, catching roughly 90% of known discrepancy cases in backtesting.
Created Tableau dashboards summarizing weekly inventory drift for regional operations managers.
Wrote ETL scripts moving CSV exports into a Postgres warehouse.
Completed a 12-week intensive fellowship building an end-to-end streaming pipeline capstone project.

projects.name: Pipeline Cost Monitor
bullets: Built a Streamlit dashboard tracking daily Snowflake compute spend, flagging anomalies roughly 24 hours faster than manual review.
Automated weekly cost reports using Python and the Snowflake API.

projects.name: Retail Demand Forecasting Pipeline
bullets: Built a Spark-based feature pipeline feeding a demand forecasting model across 200+ store locations.
Reduced feature computation time by roughly 50% by rewriting a Pandas job in PySpark.

projects.name: Open Data Quality Toolkit
bullets: Published an open-source dbt package for common data quality checks, adopted by roughly a dozen internal teams.
Wrote a Rust CLI companion tool for fast local validation before a dbt run, cutting local test time by roughly 60%.

projects.name: Home Energy Usage Tracker
bullets: Built a personal IoT dashboard for home energy usage, unrelated to the data_engineering variant's configured project list.
